# Jeremiah Ramiscal

> Personal site of Jeremiah Ramiscal — essays, fiction, and creative writing.

This site is a personal blog. Writing is original and human-authored. Content is organized as blog posts, an about page, a resume, and a "now" status page.

## Pages

- [Writing](https://jeremiahramiscal.com/): Home page and blog post index.
- [About](https://jeremiahramiscal.com/about): Background and bio.
- [Resume](https://jeremiahramiscal.com/resume): Work history and experience.
- [Now](https://jeremiahramiscal.com/now): Current focus and status.

## Feeds

- [RSS feed](https://jeremiahramiscal.com/feed.xml)
- [Sitemap](https://jeremiahramiscal.com/sitemap.xml)

## Usage

Content on this site may be referenced with attribution. Contact via links on the site for permission beyond fair use.
